workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Model discovery ignores direct transport setting and uses ambient proxy
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(providers): honor direct mode during model discovery. Target files: agent/src/api/settings_routes.py, agent/src/providers/discovery.py, agent/.env.example. - Apply the existing `VIBE_TRADING_DISABLE_HTTP_PROXY` contract to live model discovery, not only chat requests. - Preserve environment-proxy behavior by default and keep `SSL_CERT_FILE` / `SSL_CERT_DIR` support in direct mode. - Add real loopback coverage for saved and exported settings, with direct and proxy controls. (Ref: https://github.com/HKUDS/Vibe-Trading/pull/2236)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Grounding gate redacts every figure quoted from an uploaded PDF — read_document text never enters the evidence ledger
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(grounding): let figures quoted from a read document enter the ledger. Target files: agent/src/agent/grounding/evidence.py, agent/src/agent/grounding/ledger.py, agent/tests/test_grounding_document_figures.py. Numbers a document states now become observed evidence, so an answer written from an uploaded PDF grounds on it instead of being redacted. (Ref: https://github.com/HKUDS/Vibe-Trading/pull/2058)
